title: C: Ring Buffer
description: Implement a ring buffer (circular buffer) for a producer-consumer pattern.

steps.title: Ring Buffer Operations
steps.description: Define a `RingBuffer` struct with an int array of size 8, and head/tail indices. Implement `int rb_push(RingBuffer *rb, int val)` (returns 0 if full) and `int rb_pop(RingBuffer *rb, int *val)` (returns 0 if empty). Test with 3 pushes and 2 pops.
hints: Head = where next write goes, Tail = where next read comes from.
